accident_report: V1 (Car) is in Lane 3, traveling parallel to V2 in Lane 2 (V1 could be slightly behind V2). V2 (Truck) is in Lane 2, traveling slightly ahead of V1. V3 ("Phantom Vehicle") is traveling in Lane 1 behind V2 and makes an unsafe lane change from Lane 1 to Lane 2. On a straight road, V1 is in Lane 3 while V2 is in Lane 2 traveling slightly ahead of V1. V3 makes an unsafe lane change from Lane 1 to Lane 2, failing to yield to V2 who is in Lane 2. V2 makes a sudden lane change into Lane 3 to avoid a collision with the aggressive V3 who merges into Lane 2. V2 encroaches into V1's lane (Lane 3) where V1 is cruising. As a result, V1 and V2 sideswipe each other in Lane 3. A sideswipe collision occurs between V1 and V2 in Lane 3 because V2 swerved into V1's lane to avoid an unsafe maneuver by the "phantom vehicle" V3.
